title: 13 Kensington Palace Gardens

nativeAxes.x: south-southeast along the principal street facade
nativeAxes.z: west-southwest outward toward Kensington Palace Gardens

orientationControl.basis: The western projecting bay and street-facing Qualla photograph identify the entrance; long south-rear appendage is interpreted as the conservatory.

source: Generalized Protomaps building polygon plus inspected local Qualla facade photograph and article exterior/alteration description.
axis: +X south-southeast; +Z west-southwest toward the street; +Y up.
identityStatus: The nearest detached building envelope matches the front and rear projecting bays, stepped north wing and southern appendage. Number 13 is a separate residence, not Kensington Palace or the main embassy offices.
geometryLabel: Reviewed residence envelope; generalized, not surveyed

terrainContact.basis: Street-side entrance reference in the signed frame, independently sampled from host terrain.

notes: Two-storey buff masonry wings, three-storey entrance bay, white stone window surrounds and open quatrefoil parapets follow the inspected 2014 Qualla facade. The article records removal of the old bell turret and flattening of the roof in 1924; the model uses that surviving flat silhouette. Rear openings and the southern conservatory are conservative interpretations inside mapped controls.
limitations: Generalized map, photographic scale and interpreted hidden elevations are not measured architectural drawings.
Contemporary facade reference excludes the removed historic bell turret. Ground and geographic activation require separate current review.
